reviews.title: Very nice monitor
reviews.comment: This is my 2nd Z-Edge monitor. My first one went out after 5 years, and it was awesome until the very end. Tried to buy an LG monitor, but the colors looked muddy and inaccurate. This one seems to be spot on, just like my old one. And it was less expensive than the LG! I'm not a gamer, so I can't really attest to refresh rate, but it does very well in Photoshop. Nice curve and no glare, and a very good size too. I'm a fan.
reviews.author: TXBookLover

reviews.title: It's great just got a little unlucky is all but it happens.
reviews.comment:
Well I like it very much, so nice, big screen, can keep up with anything I have put on it. There is only one problem, there is one dead pixel about the center more to the right bottom corner and I just got it, it happens but I have only heard good things though about their customer service so not, not worried at all lol. Screen still worked though turned right on with my custom pc and all of the features were there and worked. I did everything I know how to troubleshoot the dead pixel but no luck it's a Sunday so not worried. still great product great for 1080p gaming nice price great performance from what I have seen and if you want to know about on board speakers it's a monitor not a TV so not loud at all or even close to being good but this is a great MONITOR that has sound. Would definitely recommend this it is very nice lol didn't even see or read about the rgb before it got here haha went off the black and white for this one and yes it's good...one dead pixel though.
To add to my previous up above, they replaced my defective product and sent me a new one. It is still working just fine, great product, great customer service. It has been a while since I bought this so I can better update with more time and good to go. Thank you for sending the new one way back and game on.
reviews.author: Ryan

reviews.title: Excellent monitor
reviews.comment: I was super skeptical about purchasing this even through online, but I have to admit I am not disappointed! The screen is beautiful, only down fall id say is the mount.  The mount appears to be super cheap and could use an update.  Aside from that, is as pictured and advertised!
reviews.author: Taylor

reviews.title: Great Monitor, great support, minor issue.
reviews.comment:
This monitor is a nice monitor. However, the first one I recieved had a dead pixel at eye level. I contacted their support and they were top notch and replaced the monitor. Unfortunately that monitor also had a dead pixel that was now in the lower right corner. I tried several applications to revive the dead pixels on both monitors to no avail.
I did not contact their support the second time as the dead pixel was not in a primary field of view and didn't obscure my vision or "catch my eye" if you will. It was in area that wasn't blinding.
The picture on the monitor is great. The colors are vibrant and it's a good monitor for the price. Refresh rates and frame rates are quick and seamless.
It would be nice to be able to control the back led lights. Of course being honest, I didnt check into it that hard. It's not that bright and with my desk LED lights I forget it even has an led on the back.
Assembly was quick and simple.
Again, their customer service was on point, and I am certain they would of replaced this monitor too, but it wasn't a major issue for me, so I didn't bother with it.
Overall a great product, my only suggestion to them is have quality control check the monitors more thoroughly before shipping them out. I will buy my second monitor from them.
reviews.author: Jeff K.

reviews.title: seems legit
reviews.comment: unless the picture quality suddenly drops off for a reason or another, thumbs up! i felt this was too good of a deal in my current situation to pass up; not to mention i was pondering upgrading to 1440p and this price point was virtually unmatched.
